experience.desc1: We are a close community built around the sea and its values. A place where learning to sail goes hand in hand with sharing, enjoying, and growing as a group.
experience.desc2: We believe in natural, accessible, pressure-free learning, where everyone finds their rhythm. Beyond the water, we are a meeting point where bonds, trust, and a way of understanding the sea are created that invites you to return.

features.title: Why choose us
features.cert_desc: Recognized qualifications to sail in any sea.
features.staff_desc: Learn from sailors with thousands of miles of experience.
features.comm_desc: Join a club of sailing and Cantabrian Sea enthusiasts.

courses_page.header_desc: At Getxo Bela Eskola we offer courses for all ages and levels, always from a close, progressive approach adapted to each person. Our goal is for everyone to find their place in the sea and learn to sail with safety, calm and confidence.

about_page.desc1: More than 15 years ago we were born in Getxo with a clear goal: to bring the sea closer to everyone from a human, educational and accessible approach. We are a non-profit association and a social project that understands sailing as a tool for learning, coexistence and personal transformation.
about_page.desc2: Over the years we have grown, professionalized and expanded activities, always with the same foundation: putting people at the center. The Eskola remains a close, simple place built from the community, and our path remains focused on accompanying people to experience the sea in a simple, safe and authentic way.
about_page.desc3: We are not a company, and we do not act as such. As a non-profit association, everything that comes in is reinvested in improving the project: renewing boats, training instructors, maintaining the facilities and expanding activities.

values.v1_desc: Located in a privileged area of the Getxo Marina, a few meters from Ereaga beach and with direct access to the Abra. We have an audiovisual classroom, well-kept changing rooms, large outdoor space, workshop and chill-out area with a small sauna.
values.v2_desc: The pontoon is our direct link to the sea. The fleet is varied: dinghy sailing, cruisers, windsurf, big SUP, paddle surf, canoes and support boats.
values.v3_desc: Here technique and care go hand in hand, because we understand that learning to sail is also learning to trust.

team.member1_desc: Our team is made up of technical people with social sensitivity, passionate about teaching and the sea. Angharad and Urko coordinate the eskola and daily operations, and also work as sports technicians.
team.member2_desc: Alongside them, we have maintenance managers, windsurfing, Optimist, Laser/420 and J80 coaches. All share a close, calm way of working based on accompaniment.
team.member3_desc: The eskola works with a simple and human relationship: the instructors listen, observe rhythms, accompany fears and encourage autonomy; the team shares decisions and the members' voice is part of the project's life.

about_page.cta_desc: Join our school and discover why we are the sailing reference in the Cantabrian Sea.
about_page.short_desc1: More than 15 years bringing the sea closer to everyone through a social, human, and accessible project. We are a non-profit association that reinvests all revenue back into the eskola, and our approach stems from a simple premise: people first.
about_page.short_desc2: The Eskola remains a welcoming, grounded space shaped by people who believe in the value of learning together on the water.

legal.rental_contract:
NAUTICAL EQUIPMENT RENTAL CONTRACT - GETXO BELA ESKOLA

1. LESSEE REQUIREMENTS: The client declares to possess the necessary technical knowledge for the safe handling of the rented material. In the case of recreational sailboats, the corresponding minimum qualification is required.

2. CONDITION AND RETURN: The material is delivered in perfect working condition. The client agrees to return it in the same condition. Any damage caused by negligence will be the exclusive responsibility of the client.

3. NAVIGATION ZONES: Navigation will be limited to authorized zones and agreed times. The client agrees to respect the rules of the Getxo Marina and the regulations of the Maritime Captaincy.

4. SAFETY: The use of a life jacket is mandatory and personal at all times while in the water.

5. RESCUE AND ASSISTANCE: If the client requires assistance or rescue due to imprudence or leaving the permitted zones, the resulting costs will be at their expense.

6. DIGITAL SIGNATURE: By checking the acceptance box, the client ratifies that they have understood all the previous points and assume their legal responsibility.
legal.course_contract:
GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF CONTRACTING - GETXO BELA ESKOLA

1. OBJECT AND SCOPE OF APPLICATION: This document establishes the legal conditions for enrollment in the courses taught by Getxo Bela Eskola.

2. PHYSICAL FITNESS AND SAFETY: The student declares that they are in suitable physical condition for navigation and do not suffer from any preventing illnesses. The use of a life jacket is mandatory, and following the instructions of the skipper or instructor is required at all times.

3. LIABILITY: Getxo Bela Eskola is not responsible for students' personal belongings. The school has the mandatory civil liability and accident insurance required by law.

4. METEOROLOGICAL CONDITIONS: The school reserves the right to cancel or postpone sessions if sea or wind conditions represent a risk to the safety of students and equipment.

5. CANCELLATION POLICY: Cancellations by the student must be communicated at least 48 hours in advance to be entitled to relocation to another date (subject to availability).

6. ACCEPTANCE: Clicking "Accept" constitutes a binding electronic signature under the current legislation on information society services.

details.title: What you need to know
details.body1: Our Udalekus are summer weeks designed for children to live the sea in an intense, fun, and safe way. The core of the camp is daily sailing, adapted to each age and level, combined with water activities like paddle surfing, Big SUP or kayaking, and group dynamics that strengthen teamwork and friendships.
details.body2: When the weather doesn't allow sailing, we organize alternatives like cooperative games, workshops, or practical theory. Every Friday we close the week with a shared snack time — a special moment to celebrate what we have lived.

cta.title: Ready to sail?

que_es_la_vela.hero_subtitle: A wonderful sport that combines technique, calm, and a deep connection with the sea. For every person, something different.
que_es_la_vela.philosophy_subtitle: You don't have to adapt to the sailing. You can choose what you want to experience and how on every outing.

cards.carta_text: Current weather reports are precise and accessible to anyone. You can choose to sail on calm days, challenging days, or any point in between. All options are valid.
cards.experiencia_text: Calm and meditation, or intensity and adrenaline. Some disconnect from work with hours of silence on the water; others seek strong winds. The sea has all of that.
cards.escenario_text: Inner Abra: protected waters to learn and relax. Outer Abra: open and exciting sea. You can start in one and explore the other whenever you want.
cards.compania_text: Small sailboats for 2–6 people, highly active and maneuverable. Or cruiser yachts for up to 8 people, ideal for team dynamics and groups who want to sail together.

que_es_la_vela.history_p1: Sailing is not an exclusively adrenaline-fueled sport nor is it reserved for those seeking extreme emotions. It can also be a gentle, meditative, and deeply relaxing practice.
que_es_la_vela.history_p1_highlight: gentle, meditative, and deeply relaxing practice.
que_es_la_vela.history_p2: There are those who go out on a small sailboat after work and, for a few hours, completely detach from land-bound worries. On the water, your mind clears on its own: you are attuned to the wind, the heading, the sound of the water, and the movement of the boat. Nothing else.
que_es_la_vela.history_p3: In the Basque Country, we have historically had a deep connection with the sea. Our towns grew because of it. Our ancestors fished in small wooden sailboats, competing to reach port first and sell their catch at the best price.
que_es_la_vela.history_p4: Sailing is part of our collective memory, even if we sometimes forget it. Today we can rebuild that connection in very different ways, each in our own style and according to what we seek at any given moment.
que_es_la_vela.selector_title: How do you want to sail today?
que_es_la_vela.calma_desc: Inner Abra, protected waters. Small sailboat, no rush. Your mind clears on its own, and for a few hours, nothing exists except the wind, the heading, and the sound of the water.
que_es_la_vela.accion_desc: Outer Abra, real wind. Speed, excitement, effort, and reward. For those who seek the intensity of the sea without filters.
que_es_la_vela.cta_title: That is why sailing remains so special.
que_es_la_vela.cta_subtitle: Because it allows you to find your own place in the sea and enjoy it in a thousand different ways.

step1.title: Welcome briefing
step1.desc: Simple explanation of roles on board, basics of sailing, and the importance of coordination. No technical jargon.

step2.title: Sailing and roles
step2.desc: The entire team on board the J80s. Every person has a real role. Manoeuvres are the practice: tacks, gybes, communication under pressure.

step3.title: Friendly regatta
step3.desc: Optional. If there are multiple boats, a friendly regatta where the focus is not on winning, but on applying what was learned. The wind equals everyone.

step4.title: Debriefing
step4.desc: Back on land. Integrating what was lived: what happened on the boat? What can be taken back to work? A conversation that closes the loop.

aprendizaje.title: It is not a one-off activity. It is an experience that changes how you communicate.
aprendizaje.quote: At the end, we hold a debriefing to integrate what was lived and apply it to the workplace.

s3_adapts.combo_calm_int_small: A quiet afternoon learning in protected waters, you and the sea.
s3_adapts.combo_calm_int_big: Social sailing in calm waters, learning together without rush.

s3_adapts.combo_action_int_big: Group adrenaline, strong wind in the inner Abra.
s3_adapts.combo_action_ext_small: Pure challenge: open sea, agile sailboat, real sensations.
s3_adapts.combo_action_ext_big: The complete experience: open sea, strong wind, your group.

card4.body: Current weather reports make it possible to predict conditions exactly. You go out when you want, with what you are looking for. Sailing is now conscious, accessible, and tailored to you.

s3_adapts_new.title:
SAILING
ADAPTS TO YOU
s3_adapts_new.subtitle:
Small or large sailboats,
calm or action-packed days,
sheltered waters or open sea.
You choose how you want to sail.

modal.title: Sailing à la carte, according to how you want to experience the sea.
modal.intro1: Sailing is not a rigid sport. It is a way of experiencing the sea that adapts to you, your time, and what you feel like doing each day.
modal.intro2: Today we have very precise weather forecasts and clear wind patterns. In our courses, you learn not only to sail but to understand and anticipate conditions. Thus, you can choose with fairly high certainty when and how to go out.
modal.experience_title: You choose the type of experience
modal.experience_1: Calm: heading out after work, disconnecting on a small or shared sailboat, sailing unhurriedly.
modal.experience_2: Action: windy days, more intensity, dynamic maneuvers, and strong sensations.
modal.scenario_1: Inner Abra: protected and calm waters, ideal for learning or relaxing.
modal.scenario_2: Outer Abra: open sea, waves, and a more lively and exciting navigation.
modal.who_title: You choose who to sail with
modal.who_1: Small sailboats: solo or in groups of 2 to 6 people, with active participation.
modal.who_2: Large sailboats (cruisers): up to 8 people, although the ideal is between 2 and 6 for a dynamic experience.
modal.modern_1: In the past, great sailors were forged because they knew how they went out, but not how they would return.
modal.modern_2: Today we can foresee conditions with great precision.
modal.modern_3: Sailing remains authentic, but now it is also more conscious, accessible, and, above all, adaptable to each person.
